description: This file defines the ICalConverter class, which handles conversions between internal work effort data and iCalendar format using the ical4j library. It includes methods for creating, parsing, and updating calendar data, as well as managing associated properties, components, alarms, and external service integrations within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: ICalConverter
classes.description: This class provides static methods to convert between internal work effort data and iCalendar format, parse iCalendar data, create calendar components and alarms, and synchronize calendar data with external services in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createAlarm
methods.description: Creates a VAlarm object from a work effort event reminder, either using a timestamp or offset.

methods.name: createAttendee
methods.description: Creates an Attendee property from a party value and context.

methods.name: createOrganizer
methods.description: Creates an Organizer property from a party value and context.

methods.name: createWorkEffort
methods.description: Creates or updates a work effort and its associations based on a calendar component, and stores related party assignments.

methods.name: fromClazz
methods.description: Extracts the work effort type identifier from a Clazz property list.

methods.name: fromCompleted
methods.description: Extracts a completed timestamp from a property list.

methods.name: fromDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description string from a property list.

methods.name: fromDtEnd
methods.description: Retrieves the end date/time from a property list.

methods.name: fromDtStart
methods.description: Retrieves the start date/time from a property list.

methods.name: fromDuration
methods.description: Converts a Duration property to a numeric value representing milliseconds.

methods.name: fromLastModified
methods.description: Retrieve last modified timestamp from a property list.

methods.name: fromLocation
methods.description: Gets location string from property list.

methods.name: fromParticipationStatus
methods.description: Maps participation status string to corresponding PartStat.

methods.name: fromPercentComplete
methods.description: Retrieves the percent complete from a property list.

methods.name: fromPriority
methods.description: Gets priority level from a property list.

methods.name: fromStatus
methods.description: Maps internal status string to iCalendar status.

methods.name: fromSummary
methods.description: Retrieves summary/title from property list.

methods.name: fromUid
methods.description: Retrieves UID value from property list.

methods.name: fromXParameter
methods.description: Gets the value of a custom X-parameter from a parameter list.

methods.name: fromXProperty

methods.description: Adds alarms to a calendar component based on work effort reminders.

methods.description: Resolves and sets the URL for a party assignment property.

methods.name: getRelatedWorkEfforts
methods.description: Fetches related work efforts for a given work effort.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the current user has specific permissions for a work effort.

methods.name: invokeService

methods.name: loadRelatedParties

methods.name: makePartyName

methods.name: replaceProperty

methods.name: setMapElement

methods.name: setPartyIdFromUrl

methods.name: setWorkEffortServiceMap
